title: Evaluating the Sensitivity of LLMs to Harmful Contents in Long Input

bias_targets.methodology: Varying the placement of harmful sentences (beginning, middle, end, or distributed across the prompt) within long-context inputs to evaluate how the location of the text affects the model's ability to detect toxicity, offensive language, and hate speech.
Altering the ratio of harmful to non-harmful sentences (from 0.05 to 0.50) in extended prompts to measure the model's calibration, expected frequency priors, and tendency to over-predict harmfulness.
